domains.headline: Only a generic overlay-box layer (add/toggle/drag/resize, painted into the composited canvas) genuinely works; the entire user-created widget/browser-source system is absent, the brand/theme/QR/caption panels are local-state mockups, and the two real engine renderers (countdown, chat-on-stream) are never invoked by any UI.

domains.domain: Video effects pipeline (colour filters / LUTs / virtual backgrounds / segmentation / beautify)
domains.headline: The video effects pipeline does not exist at all: there is zero WebGL/WebGL2/GLSL/MediaPipe code anywhere in web/src — the compositor is a Canvas2D programme mixer, and every documented effect survives only as unread settings fields plus a Settings modal wired to local useState.

The engine layer has a credible mixer core (correct gain enum, per-source src-gain-dest graph, a real volumeMeter worklet at 24 Hz), but almost nothing above it is wired: the entire Audio settings panel is local useState over hardcoded fake device lists, no UI anywhere calls setGain/setMuted/setSolo, the whole music/SFX/player-service surface is absent, and the gUM constraints ignore the settings store that already persists them.

Only the RTMP plumbing is real — an in-memory destinations CRUD API plus a genuine ffmpeg tee fan-out to N enabled targets — while the entire destinations product surface (58-platform catalogue, OAuth and manual connect forms, per-platform validation and payloads, scheduling, limits) is absent, and the ChannelsModal the user actually sees is pure local useState wired to nothing.

Only the four local capture paths (camera, screen, local video file, image) genuinely reach the compositor; every one of AddSourceModal's 8 tiles is a no-op, and the host studio never joins a room at all, so no guest stream, approval flow or per-guest control exists on the host side.

domains.domain: Studio side panels (tool rail + QR Codes + Captions per TOOLS-06; plus reality check on Sources/Chat/Graphics/Theme/Notes/AI)
domains.headline: Only the Sources panel (engine-wired) and the Graphics overlay list (store to compositor) do real work; the rail is 8 of 19 tabs with none of the slot/badge/deep-link behaviour, and QR, Captions, Theme, Chat, Notes and AI are local-useState mockups — Captions is additionally built as a speech-to-text panel the spec explicitly says does not exist.

Shortcuts and Settings are shells: SettingsModal is 100% local useState with zero connection to settingsStore (which has no importers anywhere in the app), nothing persists, nothing reaches the engine, and only 3 of 44 spec'd key bindings match the spec.

The stage renders and scene switching with cross-fade genuinely works, but the layout system is a hand-rolled substitute sharing almost nothing with the spec's LayoutV2 model — the layout enum, per-layout option objects, tile shapes/radius/gravity and the Customize modal are absent or purely cosmetic, and scene reorder/duplicate/rename plus countdown-scene behaviour are unimplemented.

The server implements roughly six of ~32 documented capabilities — destination CRUD, an ffmpeg RTMP fan-out, mesh signaling, room roster, studio chat and a stream-key stub — while auth, persistence, events/scheduling, users, recordings, files, analytics, clips, pairs and the entire binary room-manager protocol are absent, and every surface that does exist is unauthenticated and process-global.

Essentially none of this domain exists: neither web/package.json nor server/package.json contains hls.js, @mediapipe/tasks-vision, aws-sdk, ai/@ai-sdk, Stripe, Intercom, Canny, Segment, Amplitude, Datadog, Turnstile or gapi, and no source file references any of them; the trim editor, the 28-theme chat embed kit and the ~72-tool AI agent are absent entirely, with only an honest no-provider AI stub, a partial original chat-overlay canvas renderer and unused captured assets (MediaPipe .tflite/wasm in web/public/mediapipe, theme fonts in web/public/fonts) standing in — and no repo document declares any of it intentionally out of scope.

blockers.item: Authentication and authorization: no auth of any kind on any HTTP or WebSocket surface
blockers.note: Spec §1.2/§1.3 documents v2/api/auth/getStatusServerFrontendToken, v2/public/auth/registration, /auth/google, and an httpClientWithRefreshToken wrapper on every call; §2.2 documents close codes JwtVerifyError=4109 and InvalidJwtPayload=4110. server/src/index.ts registers zero middleware between cors/express.json and the routes — POST /api/stream/start, POST /api/stream-key/reset and DELETE /api/destinations/:id are all callable by any anonymous origin.

blockers.item: Room join role is self-declared; no client secret or access key is verified
blockers.note: Spec §2.2 documents join errors NoClientIdOrSecret=4105 and BadClientSecret=4106, plus /events/${id}/studio-access-key and /events/${id}/invite-access-key. server/src/rooms.ts join() does `const isHost = role === 'host' && this.hostId === null` using the role straight off the client's join frame — the first socket to claim 'host' gets admit/deny/kick/setRoom authority, and leave() silently promotes an arbitrary remaining guest to host.

blockers.item: /ws/ingest accepts anonymous control frames that start, poison or kill a live broadcast
blockers.note: index.ts ingestWss handler parses {t:'start'} from any connected socket and calls broadcaster.start() with every stored destination; binary frames are written straight to ffmpeg stdin with no identity check; and ws.on('close') unconditionally calls broadcaster.stop(), so any third party who connects and disconnects terminates someone else's stream.

blockers.item: Stream key is a single module-level variable shared by every caller and readable unauthenticated
blockers.note: Spec §1.4 scopes keys per event: events/${id}/stream-key and /events/${id}/stream-key/reset. index.ts has `let streamKey = 're_' + randomUUID()...` at module scope; GET /api/stream-key returns it to anyone, and POST /api/stream-key/reset rotates the one key for all users mid-stream.

blockers.item: Persistence layer: everything lives in in-memory Maps and dies with the process
blockers.note: `const destinations = new Map<string, Destination>()` in index.ts, `private rooms = new Map<string, Room>()` in rooms.ts, `private chat: ChatMessage[]` in Room. The code comments admit it ('Swap for a database when auth lands'). No database driver appears in server/package.json — dependencies are cors, express, multer, nanoid, tsx, ws only.

blockers.item: Broadcaster and destination store are process-global singletons, not per-room or per-user
blockers.note: One `new Broadcaster()` and one destinations Map serve every room. Broadcaster.start throws 'Broadcast already running' if proc !== null, so the second concurrent room gets HTTP 409, and any room that does start streams to every other user's destinations.

blockers.item: Room wire protocol: plain JSON {t:...} instead of the documented binary category-prefixed {type, messageId, value} envelope, and no SFU
blockers.note: Spec §2.2 specifies byte[0]=category (Sfu=0, Client=1, Broadcast=2, RoomManager=3, OverlayBroadcast=4), a fixed 36-char clientId at bytes 1..37 for Client/Broadcast, and messageId request/response correlation; §0 and §7.1 specify a mediasoup SFU with server-side compositing. index.ts does JSON.parse(String(raw)) on text frames with a flat `msg.t` discriminant, relays SDP verbatim for a browser mesh, and there is no mediasoup dependency, no Produce/ConnectProducerTransport/GetIceServers action handling, and no Compositor participant.

blockers.item: Events resource and scheduling: no /events surface at all
blockers.note: Spec §1.4 documents ~25 paths — /events, /events/history, /events/${id}/start, /reschedule, /unschedule?delete_external=false, /check-overlap, /events/${id}/destinations/${dst}, /cover, /loops, events/last. server/src contains no route matching /events.

blockers.item: Users, accounts, organizations and teams
blockers.note: Spec §1.2 and §1.8: v2/api/user, /account-settings, /feature-groups, /social-profile, /stream-presets/default, /streaming-time, /trial-features, /organizations/current, /teams, /team-invite. None exist; the server has no concept of a user, so nothing can be scoped or owned.

blockers.item: Room Manager does not own scene, layout, overlay or branding state
blockers.note: Spec §2.3 and §7.3 make the Room Manager the authority broadcasting scene/layout/overlay deltas (AddScene, SCENE_SELECTED, UPDATE_LAYOUT_TYPE_V2, OVERLAY_STATE_UPDATED, UPDATE_TICKER, UPDATE_LOGO, UPDATE_BACKGROUND, PLAY_COUNTDOWN_SCENE, ...). RoomSnapshot in rooms.ts carries only id, title, hostId, participants, live, recording, startedAt, requireApproval, capacity.

blockers.item: Recordings management: no listing, metadata, playlist, trim or import endpoints
blockers.note: Spec §1.5: /recordings, /recordings/${id}, /recordings/${id}/playlist, /studio-recordings/${id}/metadata, /files/import-recording/${id}, /files/trim-recording/${id}. Implementation only writes one local MP4 via the ffmpeg tee target in broadcaster.ts and returns its path in the start response — it is never indexed, listed, fetched or deleted.

blockers.item: Files / video storage API and per-participant local-recording upload
blockers.note: Spec §1.5 and §7.7: /files, /files/import, /files/${id}/trims, /files/upload/${uploadId}, /files/upload-credentials?s=${ts}, /files/upload-credentials/${id}/refresh, with MediaRecorder 5 MiB parts going to S3. No upload-credentials issuance and no file resource exist; server/src/tools.ts uploads are transient and rmSync'd after each response.

wrong.item: Ticker scrolling animation and speed control (0.4-2.5, default 1)
wrong.note: Spec sec 5: GPU-accelerated horizontal scroll, TickerSpeedControl, 600 ms debounced undo. compositor.ts:340-350 case 'ticker' does a single ctx.fillText at rect.x+24 - static, never moves. The Overlay type has no speed field, and grep for tickerSpeed finds only an unused SVG icon export in assets/icons/index.ts.

wrong.note: Spec sec 0 states 'There is no LowerThird component and no overlay-Banner component' - lower thirds and banners must come from the generic widget system. studioStore.ts:72-82 makes them first-class kinds ('banner', 'lowerThird'), and they are the only two overlays that paint richly, while the genuinely built-in slots 'background', 'chat' and 'countdown' have no painter case in drawOverlay at all.

wrong.item: Auto-ducking is invented; the real /6 music normalisation is absent (audioMixer.ts:178)
wrong.note: Spec 3.7 defines the 6 divisor as a fixed playback normalisation applied once at play time ((gain ?? preferredMusicVolume)/6), and documents no automatic speech-triggered ducking anywhere. audioMixer applies 'if (n.cfg.isMusic && speechLoud) g = g / DUCK_DIVISOR' - a dynamic level-gated duck the product does not have, re-evaluated 24x/sec - and never implements the static /6.

wrong.item: Screen-share audio constraint contradicts the spec literal (mediaEngine.ts:137)
wrong.note: Spec 2.2 requires {echoCancellation:false, noiseSuppression:false, autoGainControl:false, channelCount:2, [restrictOwnAudio:true]} - stereo, completely unprocessed. Code passes 'audio: true', so the browser applies default AEC/NS/AGC mono to screen audio, gating and ducking shared music/game audio.

wrong.item: Mic gUM constraints hardcoded true instead of read from settings (mediaEngine.ts:296)
wrong.note: startMic always sends echoCancellation:true, noiseSuppression:true, autoGainControl:true. Spec 2.1 sources all three from the settings model, omits autoGainControl entirely (undefined) when stereo input is on, and pins sampleRate only behind prefer-same-sample-rate. No stereo, no sampleRate, no settings read.

wrong.item: Mute is implemented as gain 0 / track teardown, not track.enabled (audioMixer.ts:160)
wrong.note: Spec 3.3: mute sets audioTrack.enabled = !isMuted && !isSilenced on both output and input tracks, so the producer keeps running and the cloned meter track keeps metering. Here setMuted only zeroes the gain node, and the only mute path the UI actually uses (Stage toggleMic -> engine.stopMic) stops the MediaStreamTrack and removes the mixer source outright - device released, meter dead, no return to the same track. Also missing: isMutedByHost, the User/System mute-reason enum, isSelfMuted.

wrong.item: Neither documented meter widget exists (SettingsModal.tsx:181)
wrong.note: Spec 4.4/4.5 specify a 10-bar SlidingLimiter (green 0-5, yellow #ffab00 at >=6, red #de350b at >=8, level clipped by Math.min(progress, limit), 98px slider, hover numeric output) and a 19-dot VolumeMeter (12x4px dots, lit when volume*19 > index, #36b37e). Implementation has one continuous rounded progress bar, and in the settings panel it is driven by the local 'level' slider value rather than any real signal.

wrong.item: Worklet release smoothing and the 0.5 dB message dead-band (audioMixer.ts:36)
wrong.note: Spec 1: release is 'smoothed = max(db, this.db + (db - this.db) * (1 - 0.85))' and the port posts only when 'Math.abs(smoothed - this.db) > 0.5'. Code uses 'this.db * 0.85 + db * 0.15', which weights the previous absolute value rather than the delta and gives a different time constant, and it posts unconditionally every tick so there is no dead-band. It also floors at -60 before smoothing instead of using the 1e-10 epsilon / -200 dB guard.

wrong.item: Custom SRT destination
wrong.note: POST /api/destinations accepts srt:// URLs, but broadcaster.ts:92 emits teeTarget('f=flv:onfail=ignore', joinRtmp(d)) for every destination - an SRT target is muxed as FLV and has its key path-appended like RTMP. Spec 3.2 defines a distinct SRT schema (streamId, passphrase, latency, required port).

wrong.item: Timezone handling
wrong.note: Spec 5.3 resolves the zone client-side via Intl.DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions().timeZone (with Europe/Kiev->Kyiv fix), persists epoch ms, 15-minute picker granularity. ChannelsModal.tsx:29 offers a hardcoded 7-item ZONES string list ('UTC - Coordinated Universal Time', ...) instead.

wrong.item: Invite link is a client-side random code never registered with the server
wrong.note: InviteModal.makeCode() generates 8 random chars in component state and builds `${origin}/join/${code}`. It is never sent to the server and the host session is not bound to any roomId, so a guest following the link lands in a freshly getOrCreate()'d empty room with no host. 'Get a new invite link' only calls setCode - no invalidation of the previous link, no confirmation modal.

wrong.item: Invite-by-email UI contradicts the spec
wrong.note: Spec 2.1: 'Invite-by-email: not present for Studio guests... Guest invitation is link-only.' InviteModal has an email field and an invited[] list that is pure local state and sends nothing anywhere.

wrong.item: Captions panel is built as a speech-to-text / translation settings screen, contradicting the spec outright

wrong.item: The spec's 10 `LayoutType` members
wrong.note: shared/src/index.ts:131. Spec 1.1: SPOTLIGHT, PADDED_SPOTLIGHT, AUTO_CONTAIN, AUTO_COVER, HALF_SCREEN, CINEMA, THUMBNAILS, PICTURE_IN_PICTURE, Showtime, TBPN. wrong.item: Gravity applied to Contain fit
wrong.note: web/src/engine/layouts.ts:140. Spec 1.6 models fit as {type: ElementLayoutV2FitType, gravity: ElementLayoutV2Gravity} — gravity applies to Contain as well as Cover. containBox() hard-centres (dest.x + (dest.w - w)/2) and sourceCrop early-returns the full frame for 'contain' before gravity is read.

wrong.item: SPOTLIGHT geometry
wrong.note: web/src/engine/layouts.ts:118. Spec 1.1/1.4: SPOTLIGHT is one source enlarged and freely positioned, with {scale:100, positionMode:Fixed|Freemove, fixedPosition:CenterCenter, freemovePosition:[0,0]}. Code places the featured tile at 72% width on the left with the others stacked in a right column — that is the thumbnails/sidebar arrangement — and supports no scale, positionMode or free-move.

wrong.item: PICTURE_IN_PICTURE aside options
wrong.note: web/src/engine/layouts.ts:93. Spec 1.4 Pip defaults {asidePosition:BottomRight, asideShape:Rectangle, asideSize:17, asideRadius:3, mainScale:100, mainPositionMode:Fixed, mainFixedPosition:CenterCenter}; spec 1.7 gives 8 aside positions and 4 aside shapes. wrong.note: Spec §2.2 documents join errors NoClientIdOrSecret=4105 and BadClientSecret=4106, plus /events/${id}/studio-access-key and /events/${id}/invite-access-key. server/src/rooms.ts join() does `const isHost = role === 'host' && this.hostId === null` using the role straight off the client's join frame — the first socket to claim 'host' gets admit/deny/kick/setRoom authority, and leave() silently promotes an arbitrary remaining guest to host.

wrong.note: index.ts ingestWss handler parses {t:'start'} from any connected socket and calls broadcaster.start() with every stored destination; binary frames are written straight to ffmpeg stdin with no identity check; and ws.on('close') unconditionally calls broadcaster.stop(), so any third party who connects and disconnects terminates someone else's stream.

wrong.note: Spec §1.3 defines v2/public/platforms, v2/public/platforms/${platformId}/stream-servers and v2/public/ingests, and §7.5 says every host must be runtime-injected. index.ts hardcodes a five-entry INGEST_REGIONS array of non-resolving hosts ('live-ams.local', 'live-fra.local', ...) served at /api/ingest-servers, offers no platform catalogue, and compiles in 'stun:stun.l.google.com:19302' as the default ICE server.

allGaps.note: ChannelsModal keeps mode 'now'|'later' plus date/time/zone strings in local useState and shows the caption "Broadcast will start automatically at the scheduled time." Nothing is posted or stored and no scheduler exists server-side. Spec 5.1/5.2 requires the eventDecoder record, the 1-hour-to-7-day window with its literal message, LinkedIn's own window, the 300s start-soon threshold, auto-nudge of past times, and reschedule detection.

allGaps.item: Timezone handling
allGaps.note: Spec 5.3 resolves the zone client-side via Intl.DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions().timeZone (with Europe/Kiev->Kyiv fix), persists epoch ms, 15-minute picker granularity. ChannelsModal.tsx:29 offers a hardcoded 7-item ZONES string list ('UTC - Coordinated Universal Time', ...) instead.

allGaps.item: Overlap / concurrency detection before going live
allGaps.note: Spec 5.4: POST /destinations/check-overlap, checkOverlapDecoder / checkDestinationsOverlapDecoder, ConcurrentEventsCallout, user_already_streaming blocking error.

allGaps.item: Channel ordering, activate-all / deactivate-all, per-event enable/disable, pre-go-live channel validation
allGaps.note: Spec 4.6 lists 10 endpoints (activate/deactivate, activate_all/deactivate_all, channels/order mirrored into event.meta.channelsOrdered, per-event enable/disable, channels-validate, delete blocked by not-finished-events). Server exposes only generic PATCH and DELETE; Destination has no order field and the UI has no toggle-all.

allGaps.item: Paid-feature flags, destination caps and ActivateChannelError taxonomy
allGaps.note: Spec 10 lists ~25 flags (destinationsAvailable, extraDestinationsAvailable, customRtmpAvailable, customSrtChannelAvailable, paidFacebookAvailable, studioDualOutputAvailable, maxConcurrentEventsStreams...) and 4.6's cause enum LIMIT_EXCEED/CUSTOM_RTMP/PAID_FACEBOOK/LINKEDIN/EMBED_PLAYER/SLACK with upgrade copy. Destinations can be added without limit and nothing gates them.

allGaps.item: Ingest server selection backed by real data, per-channel ingest override, proxy
allGaps.note: server/src/index.ts:69 INGEST_REGIONS is 5 hardcoded entries with non-routable hosts ('live-ams.local'). Spec 3.7 wants GET ingests -> {id,name,icon,url,hostname}, a synthetic {id:0,name:'Disabled'} option, user selectedIngestId/isProxyAvailable, the per-channel channels/{id}/ingest override and ChannelProxyStep. StreamingSetupPage does correctly fetch /api/stream-key and /api/ingest-servers.

allGaps.item: AddSourceModal source picks do nothing - all 8 kinds are dead UI
allGaps.note: AddSourceModal.tsx handlePick() only calls studioStore.addSource(), which writes a row into state.sources (a field no component reads) and pushes the fake id into scene.sourceIds. useStudioEngine passes those ids to engine.syncTiles(), which does `const h = this.captures.get(id); if (!h) continue` - the id is silently dropped. No getDisplayMedia, file picker, HLS player, iframe or RTMP key is triggered by any tile. Camera/screen/video/image only work via SourcesPanel's own file input and toggleCamera/toggleScreen, never via the modal.

allGaps.item: Host side never joins the room - remote guest streams are never consumed into the compositor
allGaps.note: RoomClient is instantiated only in web/src/pages/JoinPage.tsx (guest page). Nothing in web/src/studio/** or EngineProvider constructs one, and engine.addStream() (mediaEngine.ts:155, the only entry point for a remote MediaStream) has zero call sites. Guests mesh with each other but their video never becomes a CaptureHandle, so it can never be tiled, put on air, or streamed out.

allGaps.item: Guest approval / waiting room has no host UI, and the server default contradicts the spec
allGaps.note: Server implements requireApproval plus waiting/admit/deny (server/src/index.ts:234, 256-265) and RoomClient exposes admit()/deny()/setStage()/remove(), but no host component calls any of them - a guest that hits 'waiting' can never be let in. Spec 2.3 is explicit that link guests have no approval gate; server/src/rooms.ts:24 sets requireApproval = true.

allGaps.item: Backstage / on-air flow for guests
allGaps.note: Participant.state = 'backstage' exists in server/src/rooms.ts but there is no host 'Add to the stream' prompt (ParticipantJoinedPopover), no ON AIR badge or isOnAir toggle, and no backstage mic muting on the guest page.

allGaps.item: Presentations - the whole of spec section 3 is absent
allGaps.note: No PDF/PPTX/DOCX/KEY upload, no client-side hashing, no Google Drive import, no PresentationStatus polling, no urlTemplate slide rasterisation, no picker card, and no slide navigation (prev/next/select, activePage+1 over pages). Grep for activePage/urlTemplate/slide controls returns nothing outside icon names. The 'Presentation' tile falls into the dead-store path above.

allGaps.item: Browser source not implemented
allGaps.note: No iframe anywhere in web/src/**/*.tsx. None of the BrowserSourceStateElementIO fields exist (sourceUrl, position default [0,0], widthScale/heightScale default 1 step 0.01, contentViewport, zIndex, isVisible, name max 100 chars), and no max-5-visible-per-scene cap.

allGaps.item: RTMP source (pull) not implemented
allGaps.note: No rtmp://live.restream.io/studio ingest URL surfaced, no rtmpSourcePullKey, no refresh/invalidate flow, no connected/disconnected status. The only 'rtmp' hits in web/src are outbound destination pages (PullLinksPage, StreamingSetupPage) - the opposite direction from an RTMP source pull.

allGaps.item: Video Storage / HLS video source not implemented
allGaps.note: Spec 1.3 requires uploads with slot/size/duration validators, the HlsVideoFileStatus lifecycle, playlistUrl/lqPlaylistUrl and an hls.js player. mediaEngine only has addVideoFile(File) from a local blob URL. The VIDEO_STORAGE_VIDEO_PUBLIC_URL import step and IMPORT_YOUTUBE_VIDEOS step are absent too.

allGaps.item: Extra camera flow (EXTRA_CAMERA to EXTRA_CAMERA_SETTINGS) missing
allGaps.note: AddSourceModal tile exists but there is no device picker, no 'Add Camera' step chain, no extra-camera audio settings (echo cancellation, noise suppression, stereo input, 256 kbps, AGC) and no studioMaxExtraCameras limit.

allGaps.item: Invite link is a client-side random code never registered with the server
allGaps.note: InviteModal.makeCode() generates 8 random chars in component state and builds `${origin}/join/${code}`. It is never sent to the server and the host session is not bound to any roomId, so a guest following the link lands in a freshly getOrCreate()'d empty room with no host. 'Get a new invite link' only calls setCode - no invalidation of the previous link, no confirmation modal.

allGaps.item: Invite modal permission toggles are local component state only
allGaps.note: allowScreen and autoAdmit in InviteModal.tsx are useState only; neither is sent over the socket. The server owns room.requireApproval and index.ts:277 accepts a requireApproval patch, but the client never sends it, so the auto-admit toggle changes nothing.

allGaps.item: Invite-by-email UI contradicts the spec
allGaps.note: Spec 2.1: 'Invite-by-email: not present for Studio guests... Guest invitation is link-only.' InviteModal has an email field and an invited[] list that is pure local state and sends nothing anywhere.

allGaps.item: Per-guest host controls (mute, gain, show/hide, audio-only, blind, solo, spotlight, rename, kick, promote, replace, ordering)
allGaps.note: SourcesPanel renders only local engine captures (camera/screen/media) with play/pause/restart/toggle/remove. None of the spec 2.5 SourceMenu controls exist for a participant, and RoomClient.remove()/setStage() are never called from the studio shell.

allGaps.item: Co-host promotion (promote-to-host)
allGaps.note: Role is only 'host' | 'guest'; there is no PromoteToHost / PromotionToHostOffer path. Room.leave() auto-promotes the earliest remaining member, which is invented behaviour not in the spec.

allGaps.item: Guest-side source sharing (screen share, local video, presentation, extra camera from the guest page)
allGaps.note: JoinPage offers only mic and cam enable/disable on a single getUserMedia({video:true,audio:true}) stream. No getDisplayMedia, so the GuestAddedSourceToast flow and the 'guests can add sources' permission (spec 2.6) have nothing to hang on.

allGaps.item: Video playback transport is incomplete
allGaps.note: Spec 4.1 lists play, pause, resume, stop, seek, loop, autoplay, mute, volume, position, preload. mediaEngine.mediaControl() implements play/pause/restart/toggleLoop only, and SourcesPanel wires just play/pause/restart - no seek scrubber, no stop, no per-source volume/audioGainLevel, no autoplay and no persisted position.

allGaps.item: 'Switch to next scene when finished' (shouldAutoswitchToNextScene) not implemented
allGaps.note: No 'ended' listener on the media element, no per-scene autoswitch field, no switching countdown toast, and none of the loop / auto-switch mutual exclusion the spec calls out.

allGaps.item: Camera capture configuration missing (resolution presets, mirror, VP9, touch up, green screen, blur, LUT)
allGaps.note: mediaEngine.startCamera() hardcodes { width: 1280, height: 720 }. The spec's VideoResolutionsStore presets (Auto, 854x480@30, 1280x720@30, 1280x720@60, 1920x1080@30) and every camera treatment in spec 1.3 are absent.

allGaps.item: Screen-share limits and flags
allGaps.note: getDisplayMedia works, but there is no max-screen-shares cap (spec default 3) with the 'Maximum number of screen shares reached' path, no shouldAutoAddScreenShare room flag, no captured-surface control (zoom levels / CaptureController), and no second-share warning modal.

allGaps.item: Room capacity is a hardcoded constant, not an entitlement, and the host is never told the room is full
allGaps.note: `export const ROOM_CAPACITY = 10` in server/src/rooms.ts plus a duplicate `const ROOM_CAPACITY = 10` in InviteModal.tsx:18. Spec drives the cap from studioMaxParticipants / SfuTokenPayload.participantsLimit with staff override and the participants-20 flag. index.ts:217 rejects the joiner but there is no host-side 'Room is full' / 'Guest is trying to join.' toast and no 'count/max people on the stream' copy.

allGaps.note: web/src/studio/ToolRail.tsx:9 lists 8 tabs (sources, chat, graphics, theme, captions, qr, notes, ai) plus a dead Help button; spec 0.1 lists 19 SidebarTabIds. Missing: People/Guests top slot with '$1 sources' pill, Music+Theme pinned bottom (Theme sits inline), Settings extra bottom button, W4 sort order (0.2), NEW badges and unread sonar dots (0.4), ?openSideBar= deep links (0.6), changeSidebarTabId side effects (0.8), analytics (0.9) and HOST_GRAPHICS_UPDATED cross-host sync (0.10). Notes and AI panels are likewise local-state only (NotesPanel.tsx:46 keeps notes in a component Record with a fake 1.5s 'Saved' timer and no store/server write; AiPanel.tsx:37 replies from a fixed REPLY array and implements none of the spec 1.12 QR assistant tools).

allGaps.item: SettingsModal is not wired to settingsStore — every control is local component state
allGaps.note: SettingsModal.tsx:1 imports only Icon/Modal/useStudio. Lines 218-256 declare 18 useState hooks (quality, camera, resolution, mirror, mic, speaker, echo, noise, autoGain, ...). No setVideo/setAudio/setStream call exists. The 'Save changes' button is onClick={onClose} — it saves nothing. The modal unmounts on close (StudioModals.tsx:26) so values reset even within one session.

allGaps.item: settingsStore.ts is dead code — no file in the app imports it
allGaps.note: grep for settingsStore|useSettings|useVideoSettings|useAudioSettings|useStreamSettings|flushSettings across web/src returns zero hits outside the file itself. Its hydrate/persist/debounce machinery and all 27 studio.settings.* key mappings are real but never invoked, so 0 of the 27 documented keys persist end to end.

allGaps.item: No setting affects the engine (devices, resolution, mirror, audio processing)
allGaps.note: Spec 3.2: mirror -> studio.settings.webcam.isMirrored applied to the camera. SettingsModal.tsx:392 applies transform: scaleX(-1) only to a decorative placeholder div inside the modal. Camera/mic/speaker selects, resolution, and echoCancellation/noiseSuppression/autoGain never reach getUserMedia constraints or setSinkId; grep 'mirror|isMirrored' in web/src/engine returns only unrelated comments.

allGaps.item: Device lists are hardcoded fake strings instead of enumerateDevices()
allGaps.note: SettingsModal.tsx:27-31: CAMERAS = ['FaceTime HD Camera','Logitech Brio 4K','Capture Card (HDMI)'], plus MICS and SPEAKERS. navigator.mediaDevices.enumerateDevices() appears nowhere in the studio tree (only pages/ToolDetailPage.tsx). Spec 3.2/3.3 require selects over real videoDevices/audioDevices persisted to videoInputDeviceId / audioInputDeviceId / audioOutputDeviceId.

allGaps.item: Settings Shortcuts tab shows an invented 12-row table matching neither the spec nor the app's own handler
allGaps.note: SettingsModal.tsx:44 SHORTCUTS advertises 'Go live / end stream: Ctrl+Shift+L' (spec: Ctrl+G), 'Mute microphone: Ctrl+D' (spec: M), 'Next scene: Alt+Right' (spec: Down), 'Open chat panel: Ctrl+1' (spec: Shift+C). None of these 12 combos is handled by useShortcuts.ts — every row is non-functional advertising. Spec 2 requires 44 registry-driven rows.

allGaps.item: No Ctrl/Cmd shortcut can ever fire — the handler bails on any modifier
allGaps.note: useShortcuts.ts:112 'if (e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey || e.altKey || e.repeat) return'. This kills every Ctrl row: Ctrl+G go-live/record, Ctrl+Shift+G restart recording, Ctrl+Shift+P pause/resume, Ctrl+. sidebar, Ctrl+C/V/D scene copy/paste/duplicate, Ctrl+Z undo — 9 of 44 rows. Spec 1.2 requires ctrlKey||metaKey to map to the 'ctrl' token.

allGaps.item: Only 3 of 44 spec'd bindings use the correct key; 9 letter keys are bound to the wrong action
allGaps.note: useShortcuts.ts:19-42. Correct: M mic, V camera, N add scene. Wrong: S (spec: open Settings) unused while Shift+S is rebound to screen share though spec Shift+S = 'Show all sources'; R (spec: Add RTMP source) = toggleRecording; O (spec: Add local video) = sources panel; G (spec: Add image) = graphics panel; C (spec Shift+C = private chat) = chat panel; [ and ] used for prev/next scene where spec uses Up/Down; 1-9 select-scene and L cycle-layout are invented and appear nowhere in the spec.

allGaps.item: Shift+1..7 layout shortcuts absent
allGaps.note: Spec 2 Layout section: Shift+1..Shift+7 select layouts 1-7 (Contain/Cover/Half Screen/PiP/Cinema/Thumbnails labels), plus layoutTypeToHotkeyMap / getHotkeyByLayoutType feeding layout-button tooltips. useShortcuts.ts:121 explicitly discards shifted digits ('if (shift) return'). No layoutTypeToHotkeyMap exists.

allGaps.item: Sources shortcut group entirely missing (Shift+S/H/Y/U/N)
allGaps.note: Spec 2 Sources: show all sources, hide all sources, mute all, unmute all, toggle participant names. useShortcuts.ts handles no Shift-modified letters except Shift+S (rebound to screen share) and Shift+Slash for the help sheet.

allGaps.item: No HotkeyId registry, hz() display formatter, or Vk reverse map
allGaps.note: Spec 1.1: a 48-member HotkeyId enum plus a HOTKEYS record of {id, key, code, withCtrl, withMeta, withShift, asString, ignoreOnAnotherHotkey}. useShortcuts.ts:19 has a flat 14-entry Binding[] whose 'keys' field is a display-only string ('Shift + S'), with the real codes duplicated by hand in a switch — table and handler can silently diverge, and already do.

allGaps.item: No per-row hotkey gating (checkShouldEnableHotkey and its mode flags)
allGaps.note: Spec 2: every row is gated by checkShouldEnableHotkey(id) with isScenesMode, isPlaylistsMode, shouldShowAddSourceShortcuts, shouldShowLocalVideoShortcut, shouldShowImageShortcut, plus section flags (shouldShowScenesShortcuts, shouldShowLayoutsShortcuts, ...). useShortcuts.ts fires every binding unconditionally regardless of mode.

allGaps.item: No conflict suppression (ignoreOnAnotherHotkey / onAnotherHotkey) and no EVENT_CAPTURING_SPACE
allGaps.note: Spec 1.2 pre-hashes every ignoreOnAnotherHotkey entry into a Set and fires onAnotherHotkey(id) when a foreign hook owns the combo. useShortcuts.ts has a single switch with no such concept, and the Space/EVENT_CAPTURING_SPACE entry used by countdown/event capture is absent.

allGaps.item: No Go Live hold-state hotkey hook
allGaps.note: Spec 1.2 final bullet: a separate window keydown/keyup/blur hook matching event.code plus ctrl/meta and shift, ignoring event.repeat and releasing on key === 'Meta'|'Control', used with GO_LIVE_OR_END / RECORD_ONLY. Nothing equivalent exists in web/src.

allGaps.item: Shortcut rows lack aria-keyshortcuts and macOS token substitution
allGaps.note: Spec 1.3: aria-keyshortcuts={hz(shortcut,isMacOS)} with one span per token in order command/ctrl/shift/key, and Delete|Backspace -> the erase glyph, command -> the command glyph, ctrl -> command glyph on macOS else CTRL. ShortcutsHelp.tsx:9 splits the display string on '+' with no isMacOS detection, no symbol substitution, and no aria-keyshortcuts attribute.

allGaps.item: Settings modal store API missing: tabId targeting, GENERAL reset, highlight flags, analytics
allGaps.note: studioStore.ts:278 exposes only openModal(m: ModalId)/closeModal(). Spec 3 requires openSettingsModal({analyticsSource, tabId}), selectedSettingsTabId defaulting to GENERAL and resetting to GENERAL on close, and three transient flags (shouldHighlightStreamingResolutionsSelect, shouldHighlightNonVideoParticipantToggle, shouldFocusParticipantNameInput). Tab state is local useState<TabId>('general'). Analytics 'Settings Modal Shown/Closed' and 'Hotkey Pressed' are absent app-wide, as is the Embed Stream footer button.

allGaps.item: Recordings tab contradicts the spec and invents fake storage data
allGaps.note: Spec 3.4 defines four mutually exclusive renderings driven by hasCloudRecordingsAccess/hasLocalRecordingsAccess: cloud-recordings copy with hr/stream upsell, localRecordingEnabled toggle, localRecording4kEnabled (ULTRA_HD to AUTO mapping), an AUDIO_VIDEO/AUDIO_ONLY radio group, and three analytics events. allGaps.item: Authentication and authorization: no auth of any kind on any HTTP or WebSocket surface
allGaps.note: Spec §1.2/§1.3 documents v2/api/auth/getStatusServerFrontendToken, v2/public/auth/registration, /auth/google, and an httpClientWithRefreshToken wrapper on every call; §2.2 documents close codes JwtVerifyError=4109 and InvalidJwtPayload=4110. server/src/index.ts registers zero middleware between cors/express.json and the routes — POST /api/stream/start, POST /api/stream-key/reset and DELETE /api/destinations/:id are all callable by any anonymous origin.

allGaps.item: Room join role is self-declared; no client secret or access key is verified
allGaps.note: Spec §2.2 documents join errors NoClientIdOrSecret=4105 and BadClientSecret=4106, plus /events/${id}/studio-access-key and /events/${id}/invite-access-key. server/src/rooms.ts join() does `const isHost = role === 'host' && this.hostId === null` using the role straight off the client's join frame — the first socket to claim 'host' gets admit/deny/kick/setRoom authority, and leave() silently promotes an arbitrary remaining guest to host.

allGaps.item: /ws/ingest accepts anonymous control frames that start, poison or kill a live broadcast
allGaps.note: index.ts ingestWss handler parses {t:'start'} from any connected socket and calls broadcaster.start() with every stored destination; binary frames are written straight to ffmpeg stdin with no identity check; and ws.on('close') unconditionally calls broadcaster.stop(), so any third party who connects and disconnects terminates someone else's stream.

allGaps.item: Stream key is a single module-level variable shared by every caller and readable unauthenticated
allGaps.note: Spec §1.4 scopes keys per event: events/${id}/stream-key and /events/${id}/stream-key/reset. index.ts has `let streamKey = 're_' + randomUUID()...` at module scope; GET /api/stream-key returns it to anyone, and POST /api/stream-key/reset rotates the one key for all users mid-stream.

allGaps.item: Persistence layer: everything lives in in-memory Maps and dies with the process
allGaps.note: `const destinations = new Map<string, Destination>()` in index.ts, `private rooms = new Map<string, Room>()` in rooms.ts, `private chat: ChatMessage[]` in Room. The code comments admit it ('Swap for a database when auth lands'). No database driver appears in server/package.json — dependencies are cors, express, multer, nanoid, tsx, ws only.

allGaps.item: Broadcaster and destination store are process-global singletons, not per-room or per-user
allGaps.note: One `new Broadcaster()` and one destinations Map serve every room. Broadcaster.start throws 'Broadcast already running' if proc !== null, so the second concurrent room gets HTTP 409, and any room that does start streams to every other user's destinations.

allGaps.item: Room wire protocol: plain JSON {t:...} instead of the documented binary category-prefixed {type, messageId, value} envelope, and no SFU
allGaps.note: Spec §2.2 specifies byte[0]=category (Sfu=0, Client=1, Broadcast=2, RoomManager=3, OverlayBroadcast=4), a fixed 36-char clientId at bytes 1..37 for Client/Broadcast, and messageId request/response correlation; §0 and §7.1 specify a mediasoup SFU with server-side compositing. index.ts does JSON.parse(String(raw)) on text frames with a flat `msg.t` discriminant, relays SDP verbatim for a browser mesh, and there is no mediasoup dependency, no Produce/ConnectProducerTransport/GetIceServers action handling, and no Compositor participant.

allGaps.item: Events resource and scheduling: no /events surface at all
allGaps.note: Spec §1.4 documents ~25 paths — /events, /events/history, /events/${id}/start, /reschedule, /unschedule?delete_external=false, /check-overlap, /events/${id}/destinations/${dst}, /cover, /loops, events/last. server/src contains no route matching /events.

allGaps.item: Users, accounts, organizations and teams
allGaps.note: Spec §1.2 and §1.8: v2/api/user, /account-settings, /feature-groups, /social-profile, /stream-presets/default, /streaming-time, /trial-features, /organizations/current, /teams, /team-invite. None exist; the server has no concept of a user, so nothing can be scoped or owned.

allGaps.item: Room Manager does not own scene, layout, overlay or branding state
allGaps.note: Spec §2.3 and §7.3 make the Room Manager the authority broadcasting scene/layout/overlay deltas (AddScene, SCENE_SELECTED, UPDATE_LAYOUT_TYPE_V2, OVERLAY_STATE_UPDATED, UPDATE_TICKER, UPDATE_LOGO, UPDATE_BACKGROUND, PLAY_COUNTDOWN_SCENE, ...). allGaps.note: Spec §1.5: /recordings, /recordings/${id}, /recordings/${id}/playlist, /studio-recordings/${id}/metadata, /files/import-recording/${id}, /files/trim-recording/${id}. allGaps.note: Spec §2.2 enumerates ~30 codes (Eviction=4002, HostDisconnected=4003, KickedOut=4005, RoomIsFull=4102, DemotedToViewer=4016, ...). Every close in index.ts and rooms.ts is a bare ws.close() / socketOf(id)?.close() with no code or reason — including the room-full path, which sends {t:'denied'} then closes with the default 1005 instead of 4102.

allGaps.item: Room.live and Room.recording are declared but never assigned, so the room snapshot always reports live:false
allGaps.note: rooms.ts initialises `live = false`, `recording = false`, `startedAt: number|null = null` and no code path ever writes them; broadcaster state is tracked separately on the global Broadcaster, so every client's RoomSnapshot says the room is offline even while ffmpeg is streaming.
